sentences.en: Silk is a fine, smooth material produced from the cocoons - soft protective shells - that are made by mulberry silkworms (insect larvae).
sentences.zh: 丝绸是一种细腻、光滑的材料,由桑蚕（昆虫幼虫）制成的茧（柔软的保护壳）制成。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Legend has it that it was Lei Tzu, wife of the Yellow Emperor, ruler of China in about 3000 BC, who discovered silkworms.
sentences.zh: 传说是公元前约 3000 年中国统治者黄帝的妻子雷子发现了蚕。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: One account of the story goes that as she was taking a walk in her husband's gardens, she discovered that silkworms were responsible for the destruction of several mulberry trees.
sentences.zh: 这个故事的一个说法是,当她在丈夫的花园里散步时,她发现蚕破坏了几棵桑树。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: She collected a number of cocoons and sat down to have a rest.
sentences.zh: 她收集了一些茧,坐下来休息。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It just so happened that while she was sipping some tea, one of the cocoons that she had collected landed in the hot tea and started to unravel into a fine thread.
sentences.zh: 正巧,她在喝茶的时候,她采到的一个蚕茧落在了热茶里,开始散开成一根细丝。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Lei Tzu found that she could wind this thread around her fingers.
sentences.zh: 雷子发现她可以把这根线绕在手指上。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Subsequently, she persuaded her husband to allow her to rear silkworms on a grove of mulberry trees.
sentences.zh: 随后,她说服了丈夫,允许她在桑树林里养蚕。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: She also devised a special reel to draw the fibres from the cocoon into a single thread so that they would be strong enough to be woven into fabric.
sentences.zh: 她还设计了一种特殊的卷轴,将茧中的纤维拉成单线,这样它们就足够坚固,可以织成织物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: While it is unknown just how much of this is true, it is certainly known that silk cultivation has existed in China for several millennia.
sentences.zh: 虽然不知道其中有多少是真实的,但众所周知,丝绸种植在中国已经存在了几千年。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Originally, silkworm farming was solely restricted to women, and it was they who were responsible for the growing, harvesting and weaving.
sentences.zh: 最初,养蚕仅限于女性,她们负责种植、收获和编织。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Silk quickly grew into a symbol of status, and originally, only royalty were entitled to have clothes made of silk.
sentences.zh: 丝绸很快成为身份的象征,最初只有皇室成员才有资格拥有丝绸制成的衣服。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The rules were gradually relaxed over the years until finally during the Qing Dynasty (1644-1911 AD), even peasants, the lowest caste, were also entitled to wear silk.
sentences.zh: 多年来,这些规定逐渐放宽,直到清朝（公元1644-1911年）,即使是最低种姓的农民也有权穿着丝绸。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Sometime during the Han Dynasty (206 BC-220 AD), silk was so prized that it was also used as a unit of currency.
sentences.zh: 在汉朝（公元前 206 年至公元 220 年）的某个时候,丝绸非常珍贵,以至于它也被用作货币单位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Government officials were paid their salary in silk, and farmers paid their taxes in grain and silk.
sentences.zh: 官吏以丝发俸,农民以粮帛纳税。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Silk was also used as diplomatic gifts by the emperor.
sentences.zh: 丝绸也被皇帝用作外交礼物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Fishing lines, bowstrings, musical instruments and paper were all made using silk.
sentences.zh: 鱼线、弓弦、乐器和纸张都是用丝绸制成的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The earliest indication of silk paper being used was discovered in the tomb of a noble who is estimated to have died around 168 AD.
sentences.zh: 最早使用丝纸的迹象是在一位贵族的坟墓中发现的,该贵族估计死于公元 168 年左右。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Demand for this exotic fabric eventually created the lucrative trade route now known as the Silk Road, taking silk westward and bringing gold, silver and wool to the East.
sentences.zh: 对这种异国面料的需求最终创造了利润丰厚的贸易路线,现在被称为丝绸之路,将丝绸带到西方,并将金、银和羊毛带到东方。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It was named the Silk Road after its most precious commodity, which was considered to be worth more than gold.
sentences.zh: 它因其最珍贵的商品而被命名为丝绸之路,这种商品被认为比黄金更有价值。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The Silk Road stretched over 6,000 kilometres from Eastern China to the Mediterranean Sea, following the Great Wall of China, climbing the Pamir mountain range, crossing modern-day Afghanistan and going on to the Middle East, with a major trading market in Damascus.
sentences.zh: 丝绸之路从中国东部延伸至地中海,全长6000多公里,沿着中国长城,翻越帕米尔山脉,穿越现代阿富汗,一直延伸到中东,主要贸易市场在大马士革。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: From there, the merchandise was shipped across the Mediterranean Sea.
sentences.zh: 从那里,商品被运过地中海。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Few merchants travelled the entire route; goods were handled mostly by a series of middlemen.
sentences.zh: 很少有商人走完全程；货物主要由一系列中间商处理。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: With the mulberry silkworm being native to China, the country was the world's sole producer of silk for many hundreds of years.
sentences.zh: 由于桑蚕原产于中国,数百年来中国一直是世界上唯一的丝绸生产国。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The secret of silk-making eventually reached the rest of the world via the Byzantine Empire, which ruled over the Mediterranean region of southern Europe, North Africa and the Middle East during the period 330-1453 AD.
sentences.zh: 丝绸制作的秘密最终通过公元330-1453年期间统治南欧、北非和中东地中海地区的拜占庭帝国传到了世界各地。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: According to another legend, monks working for the Byzantine emperor Justinian smuggled silkworm eggs to Constantinople (Istanbul in modern-day Turkey) in 550 AD, concealed inside hollow bamboo walking canes.
sentences.zh: 根据另一个传说,公元 550 年,为拜占庭皇帝查士丁尼工作的僧侣将蚕卵藏在空心竹制手杖内走私到君士坦丁堡（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔）。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The Byzantines were as secretive as the Chinese, however, and for many centuries the weaving and trading of silk fabric was a strict imperial monopoly.
sentences.zh: 然而,拜占庭人和中国人一样神秘,许多世纪以来,丝绸织物的编织和贸易都是严格的帝国垄断。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Then in the seventh century, the Arabs conquered Persia, capturing their magnificent silks in the process.
sentences.zh: 然后在七世纪,阿拉伯人征服了波斯,在此过程中夺取了他们华丽的丝绸。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Silk production thus spread through Africa, Sicily and Spain as the Arabs swept through these lands.
sentences.zh: 随着阿拉伯人席卷非洲、西西里岛和西班牙,丝绸生产也传遍了这些地区。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Andalusia in southern Spain was Europe's main silk producing centre in the tenth century.
sentences.zh: 西班牙南部的安达卢西亚是十世纪欧洲主要的丝绸生产中心。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: By the thirteenth century, however, Italy had become Europe's leader in silk production and export.
sentences.zh: 然而,到了十三世纪,意大利已成为欧洲丝绸生产和出口的领导者。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Venetian merchants traded extensively in silk and encouraged silk growers to settle in Italy.
sentences.zh: 威尼斯商人广泛进行丝绸贸易,并鼓励丝绸种植者在意大利定居。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Even now, silk processed in the province of Como in northern Italy enjoys an esteemed reputation.
sentences.zh: 即使现在,意大利北部科莫省的丝绸加工仍享有盛誉。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The nineteenth century and industrialisation saw the downfall of the European silk industry.
sentences.zh: 十九世纪和工业化见证了欧洲丝绸业的衰落。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Cheaper Japanese silk, trade in which was greatly facilitated by the opening of the Suez Canal, was one of the many factors driving the trend.
sentences.zh: 更便宜的日本丝绸是推动这一趋势的众多因素之一,苏伊士运河的开通大大促进了贸易。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Then in the twentieth century, new manmade fibres, such as nylon, started to be used in what had traditionally been silk products, such as stockings and parachutes.
sentences.zh: 然后在二十世纪,新型人造纤维（例如尼龙）开始用于传统的丝绸产品,例如长袜和降落伞。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The two world wars, which interrupted the supply of raw material from Japan, also stifled the European silk industry.
sentences.zh: 两次世界大战,中断了日本的原材料供应,也扼杀了欧洲的丝绸业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: After the Second World War, Japan's silk production was restored, with improved production and quality of raw silk.
sentences.zh: 第二次世界大战后,日本的丝绸生产得到恢复,生丝的产量和质量得到提高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Japan was to remain the world's biggest producer of raw silk, and practically the only major exporter of raw silk, until the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 直到 1970 年代,日本仍是世界上最大的生丝生产国,并且实际上是唯一的主要生丝出口国。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, in more recent decades, China has gradually recaptured its position as the world's biggest producer and exporter of raw silk and silk yarn.
sentences.zh: 然而,近几十年来,中国逐渐重新夺回了世界最大生丝和丝纱生产国和出口国的地位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Today, around 125,000 metric tons of silk are produced in the world, and almost two-thirds of that production takes place in China.
sentences.zh: 如今,世界上生产了约 125,000 吨丝绸,其中近三分之二是在中国生产的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。
